title: Engine v1 IP catalogue entry contract
$comment: Authoritative meta.yaml shape for rocket-blocks catalogue entries (<root>/<pdk>/<entry>/rocket/meta.yaml). This file is the single source: src/project/ip/blocks.py verifies every entry against this exact document at runtime. Filesystem-level rules the schema cannot see stay in resolve_block_ref: the entry must live inside its owning <root>/<pdk>/ scope, the folder name must be a lowercase-with-dashes slug, the meta name must agree with the folder, and an entry wrapping a nested upstream checkout (entry_repo/) must declare upstream provenance.

IpEntryUpstream.description: Provenance of a wrapped nested upstream checkout (entry_repo/): where it came from, which revision, under which license. Mandatory exactly when entry_repo/ is present.

IpEntryPort.description: One block port (symbol pin or cell terminal). Only the name is contracted today; domain nests standardize later without breaking this shape.

IpEntry.description: Catalogue entry identity plus adapter metadata. Top level is closed (unknown keys fail loudly) so future fields arrive through deliberate schema evolution; port nests stay open until their standard lands. name must equal the entry folder slug; version pins the entry revision a registry block resolves to.
